findings.claim: Generation is hierarchical: biome order, storyline, local content. Launch-era statement, not current DLC count.
Campaign ActivateFirstValidWorld tests instantiated subquests in World1/2/3 order and activates the first valid waypoint; this is activation, not random selection.
Adventure wrapper subquest tags pair Story with Fae, Jungle or Nerud; native matching implementation unread.
A local fog volume has overlap actions and stop-action exit instructions.
Archetype progression is independent, unlockable and ordered in dual configuration.
Archetype definitions link engram, archetype UI, trait type and stat table; some unlock tables fail decoding.
EventTree exports contain choice, item condition, event trigger, reward, removal and cooldown types. Many records partial.
Bark state machine reads speaking/cinematic tags, combat, health, range and LOS conditions.
Third-party save reader has compressed profile/world files and mode-specific event parsing. It does not prove game migrations or corruption recovery.
Remnant supports a shared portable combat build more directly than distinct metaphysical power conversion or transferable NPC authority.
